summary: End-to-end money-path trace complete: 6 dead-ends, 1 open conversion door, full file inventory for affiliate integration.
findings: THREAD: visitor lands on /blog/how-to-lower-electric-bill-complete-guide/ → 301 → /blog/05-how-to-lower-utility-bills/ (file: public/.htaccess:31). The target page has ZERO product boxes, ZERO amazon links, ZERO affiliate disclosure. The original URL is a Hugo draft (draft: true in content front-matter, file: content/blog/... line 15) so it never generates HTML. Traffic hits a generic priority guide with no purchase intent.

THREAD CONT.: The analytics top page is /blog/how-to-lower-electric-bill-complete-guide/ (123 sessions, 92.68% bounce, 40.5s avg time). This is the 301 URL — visitors land and immediately leave because the content doesn't match the title's promised 'lower electric bill complete guide'. The redirect was set up during category consolidation (SQ-016 Phase A).

PRODUCT BOXES EXIST but are mis-configured: add_product_boxes.py (file: root/) wrote product-box shortcodes to 3 files via JOBS dict. Verified in content/ via search: how-to-lower-electric-bill-complete-guide.md (draft, not published), 30-sudden-spike...md (published, Kill A Watt), 07-gas-bill-too-high.md (published, Nest Thermostat). The 2 published pages DO render product boxes in public/ (verified in public HTML).

TAG MISMATCH: hugo.toml line 10 sets amazon_tag='litwd-20'. The owner's store ID is 'utexplained-20' (evidence-brief ¶3). Zero hits for 'utexplained-20' anywhere in repo. Every amazon link built before this fix attributes earnings to the wrong affiliate tag.

AFFILIATE DISCLOSURE positioning: add_product_boxes.py injects {{< affiliate-disclosure >}} after front-matter. The shortcode renders a div (file: layouts/shortcodes/affiliate-disclosure.html). In the published 07-gas-bill-too-high/index.html, the disclosure renders above the Quick Answer, before all product boxes. This is FTC-compliant positioning. But the disclosure is ONLY present in 07-gas-bill-too-high and 30-sudden-spike — the 3rd target (complete-guide) is draft. Zero articles have both product boxes AND the affiliate-disclosure shortcode in the same published file.

EMAIL CAPTURE: exists as a Mailchimp post form (layouts/partials/email-capture.html, action=https://utilityexplained.us21.list-manage.com/subscribe/post). Renders at the VERY BOTTOM of every blog article (single.html line ~100), after sources, author bio. This is correct 'earned not begged' positioning but results in extremely low capture given the 91.3% bounce and 1.10 pages/session.

SEARCH: /search/ page exists (layouts/_default/search.html) with Fuse.js client-side search across all blog posts. Index is embedded JSON. Has popular-guides default state. Search functions but is a dead end for monetization — no product placement in search results.
HUBS: 6 hub pages use hub.html layout. No product boxes, no amazon links in any hub template. The hub directory auto-generates link lists from front-matter hub_categories.
RELATED POSTS: theme partial (adsense-base/layouts/partials/related-posts.html) scores by category+tags, renders 3 related article cards. No monetization in related-posts template.

NAVIGATION: Main menu has 6 hub links. Secondary has All Guides, About, Authors, Contact. Footer has Privacy, Terms, Disclaimer. The /affiliate-disclosure/ page exists as a static content page (verified via public directory listing).
NO amazon.com links anywhere in content/ (grep verified, evidence-brief ¶3). Zero affiliate revenue currently flowing.

PUBLISHED product-box pages: 07-gas-bill-too-high (Nest thermostat, tag=litwd-20) and 30-sudden-spike-in-electricity-bill-no-usage (Kill A Watt P4400, tag=litwd-20). Both have affiliate-disclosure injected and product boxes that link to amazon.com with the wrong tag.

The add_product_boxes.py script targeted 8 files but only succeeded on 3 (the others had existing product-box shortcodes 'SKIP' or couldn't find anchors 'no anchor'). Script hasn't been re-run recently and is not integrated into the build pipeline.

AdSense script tags STILL appear in the public HTML (e.g., 07-gas-bill-too-high/index.html has Google Adsense ca-pub-... script loaded despite ADR-006 removal claim). The git commit removed templates but the public build wasn't regenerated after removal.
